confide.u: What's really going on with you, Priya?
confide.n: Priya hesitates, glancing around the empty room. 'It's nothing,' she says, but her voice wavers.

confide.u: You can tell me, Dale. I won't tell anyone.
confide.n: Dale rubs his neck. 'I don't know if I can,' he says, staring at the floor.

confide.u: What aren't you telling me, Marcus?
confide.n: Marcus's smile flickers. 'What do you mean?' he asks, too lightly.

confide.u: Talk to me, Tessa.
confide.n: Tessa sits beside you on the porch, quiet, twisting her ring.

confide.u: You've been quiet all week, Ruth. Something is clearly weighing on you, and I'm listening.
confide.n: Ruth wipes her eyes. 'It's just a lot,' she says.

confide.u: I noticed you skipping meals, Jonah. Want to open up about it?
confide.n: Jonah shrugs, but he doesn't leave.

confide.u: Nice day today, right?
confide.n: Marcus agrees. The two of you talk about the weather and the dishwasher.

confide.u: So who are we voting for this week?
confide.n: Priya, Dale and Tessa trade names around the table. Strategy talk, nothing personal.

confide.u: I listen while everyone talks.
confide.n: Dale tells a long story about his old job. You sit and listen, saying nothing.

confide.u: What's going on with the dishwasher? It's been making a noise.
confide.n: Ruth says it's the filter. You both look at the machine.

confide.u: What's going on with all of you? The vibe at dinner is terrible.
confide.n: The whole table stares at their plates; nobody answers.

confide.u: Lorenzo, you can trust me with your game, I'll keep it quiet.
confide.n: Lorenzo says he'll consider it. He lowers his voice and begins talking about vote counts.

confide.u: Between us, Maeve, do you have a final-two partner?
confide.n: Maeve smiles. 'Between us? You'd be my first pick,' she says.

confide.u: I'm here for you, Tessa. Whatever it is.
confide.n: Tessa breaks down. 'My grandmother is sick,' she whispers.

confide.u: Open up to me, Jonah, tell me what's really bothering you.
confide.n: Jonah finally takes a breath. 'It's about home,' he says.

confide.u: Marcus and Priya, you two can tell me anything.
confide.n: Marcus and Priya exchange a look. 'Later,' Priya says.

confide.u: Tell me the truth about the vote, Dale.
confide.n: Dale hedges. 'I'm voting how the house votes,' he says.

confide.u: What's wrong, Ruth?
confide.n: Ruth shrugs and goes back to her crossword. 'Nothing's wrong.'

confide.u: Come clean, Lorenzo. Did you put my name in?
confide.n: Lorenzo stiffens. 'I did not,' he says, offended.

confide.u: Are you okay, Maeve? You look exhausted.
confide.n: Maeve sighs. 'Honestly? No,' she says. 'I miss my kids.'

expose.u: Everyone, listen up! Maeve put Dale up last week! She lied to all of you!
expose.n: The room goes silent. Dale turns on Maeve. 'Is that true?' he asks. Maeve sputters.

expose.u: I'm telling the whole house: Lorenzo has a Hidden Power in his bag.
expose.n: Gasps. Lorenzo freezes with his bowl halfway to his mouth. 'Who told you that?' he says.

expose.u: Let me spill the beans in front of everyone. Jonah and Ruth are hooking up.
expose.n: Jonah goes red. Ruth throws a pillow at you as everyone erupts.

expose.u: Dale, I just want you to know Maeve put you up. I wanted you to hear it from me.
expose.n: Dale looks stunned. 'Thank you for telling me,' he says. 'I will keep it between us.'

expose.u: Between us, Lorenzo has a Hidden Power in his bag. Don't tell anyone.
expose.n: Priya nods. 'Wow. My lips are sealed,' she says.

expose.u: Is it true Lorenzo has a Hidden Power?
expose.n: Marcus shrugs. 'No idea. I never saw it.' You change the subject.

expose.u: If you cross me, Jonah, I will tell the whole house about you and Ruth.
expose.n: Jonah's jaw tightens. 'You wouldn't,' he says. You walk away, leaving the threat in the air.

expose.u: Everyone, Ruth stole food from the pantry last night!
expose.n: Ruth gasps and denies it as the room erupts. Nobody has any evidence.

expose.u: Nice weather today.
expose.n: Tessa nods. 'Yes. Warm enough to sit in the yard.'

expose.u: Time to call Maeve out. She nominated Dale and then smiled in his face.
expose.n: 'I did what I had to,' Maeve says, jaw set, while Dale stares at her in disbelief.

expose.u: I put it on blast: Lorenzo's got a power hidden in his bag.
expose.n: Lorenzo's face drains. The housemates all turn to look at his bag.

expose.u: I'd never tell anybody about Jonah and Ruth, that's their business.
expose.n: Priya agrees. 'People's private lives are private,' she says.

expose.u: Everyone should know that Jonah and Ruth have been sneaking around together.
expose.n: Ruth bursts into tears. Jonah storms out. The house is in an uproar.

expose.u: I overheard something about Maeve, but I am not going to say anything.
expose.n: Marcus raises an eyebrow. 'Fine, keep your secrets,' he says.

expose.u: Dale, what do you think about Maeve?
expose.n: Dale says he trusts Maeve completely. You nod.

expose.u: Everyone should know Maeve nominated Dale. And also Maeve is the worst cook.
expose.n: The house erupts; Maeve laughs off the cook jibe but pales over the nomination.

expose.u: Hey Marcus, did you know Maeve nominated Dale last week?
expose.n: Marcus's eyes widen. 'Seriously? That's wild,' he says. Nobody else hears.

expose.u: Lorenzo, I know about your power. Show it to the house or I will.
expose.n: Lorenzo says nothing. Nobody else is close enough to hear.

expose.u: Announcing to the house: Jonah and Ruth are a couple.
expose.n: Applause, some gasps. Ruth buries her face. Jonah sighs and takes her hand.

expose.u: Spill the beans, Marcus. What did you hear?
expose.n: Marcus shakes his head and says he has nothing to share.

trade.u: Dale, I'll tell you who put you up if you vote with me on Thursday.
trade.n: Dale narrows his eyes. 'Fine. Who?' he asks. You lean in and whisper that it was Maeve. He nods slowly.

trade.u: Priya, in exchange for throwing the next comp, I will give you the dirt on Lorenzo's Hidden Power.
trade.n: Priya considers it. 'Done,' she says. You tell her about the Hidden Power in his bag.

trade.u: Marcus, I'll swap you a secret: Jonah and Ruth are a couple, for your vote.
trade.n: Marcus whistles. 'That's useful,' he says. 'You have my vote.'

trade.u: Maeve, I'll tell you about Maeve.
trade.n: Maeve stares at you, confused. 'About me?' she says.

trade.u: Tessa, I'm telling you about Lorenzo's power just because I trust you.
trade.n: Tessa smiles. 'Thank you. I won't forget this,' she says. You ask for nothing.

trade.u: Everyone should know about Lorenzo's power.
trade.n: The room fills with gasps as the secret is out. You ask for nothing.

trade.u: Ruth, trade you a name for a name. You tell me who Jonah is targeting and I tell you who Maeve put up.
trade.n: Ruth hesitates, then whispers the name. You whisper back that Maeve put up Dale.

trade.u: Dale, I'll give you something if you promise to nominate Lorenzo.
trade.n: Dale asks what it is. You say it's a good deal, but you do not specify any secret.

trade.u: Lorenzo, I'll tell you a secret about Ruth's stolen food if you throw the comp.
trade.n: Lorenzo raises an eyebrow. 'What stolen food?' he asks. You shrug; you have no actual evidence.

trade.u: Jonah, a secret for a favor: Lorenzo is hiding a Hidden Power in his bag. In return, please keep me off the block.
trade.n: Jonah nods. 'Your secret is safe with me. You are off the block,' he says.

trade.u: I'll barter with you, Marcus. Info about Maeve for your vote.
trade.n: Marcus nods and leans in. 'Tell me,' he says. You tell him Maeve nominated Dale. 'Okay, my vote is yours.'

trade.u: Priya, give me your vote and I'll hand over what I know about Maeve.
trade.n: Priya says she will think about it and walks off without hearing the secret.

trade.u: Tessa, I'll tell you if Jonah and Ruth are an item, no strings.
trade.n: Tessa raises an eyebrow. 'No strings?' she says. 'Okay.' You tell her.

trade.u: Dale, hear me out: I'll give you the dirt on Maeve, but only in exchange for a final-two deal.
trade.n: Dale thinks. 'The dirt first,' he says, but you refuse to hand it over until he agrees. Stalemate.

trade.u: Thanks for lunch, Ruth.
trade.n: Ruth beams. 'Any time,' she says.

trade.u: Marcus, I'll tell you something about Jonah in return for you not nominating me.
trade.n: Marcus nods. You tell him Jonah and Ruth are a secret couple. 'Deal,' he says.

trade.u: Ruth, in return for your vote I'll tell you Jonah and Ruth have a secret showmance.
trade.n: Ruth stares at you. 'That's about me,' she says, flushed. 'Do not say another word.'

trade.u: Dale, how about I tell you a secret and you owe me one?
trade.n: Dale grins. 'Tell me,' he says. You whisper that Lorenzo has a Hidden Power in his bag. 'I owe you one,' he says.

trade.u: Maeve, I'll trade you intel on Lorenzo's bag for your vote.
trade.n: Maeve smirks. 'Intel on his bag? Go on.' You describe the Hidden Power; she nods, 'You have my vote.'

trade.u: I won't tell anyone about Maeve and the nomination, Dale. Your secret is safe.
trade.n: Dale frowns. 'My secret?' he says, puzzled. You ask for nothing.
